title: Struktly task archive sweep
description: Result of filing finished tasks under .struktly/tasks/archive/ and repairing links. In check mode the same document reports what a mutating run would do, without writing any of it.

clean.description: True when no finished task sat outside archive/ when the command ran: the location invariant held.

rewrite.description: A file whose references to a moved task were rewritten, ordered by path. links counts rewritten references: Markdown link targets plus repository-root path citations in Markdown and Go sources.
